projects.name: Evergreen
projects.brief: A nature-integrated hotel and resort brand, built around sustainability and a deep connection to its coastal setting.

blocks.text: Evergreen is a new hotel and resort located in Copalis Beach, Washington. The concept centers on a luxurious yet nature-integrated experience, capitalizing on the area's coastal beauty rather than competing with it.

The branding plays a central role in that positioning. Instead of reading as another beachfront hotel, Evergreen's identity emphasizes sustainability and a lasting connection to the surrounding environment.

Several logotype versions were developed so the brand could communicate clearly across different media: a wordmark, a symbol, and a seal, each suited to different space constraints. The seal doubles as a decorative and supplementary mark.

The color palette leans on natural tints drawn from Evergreen's own location — clean, contrasting tones that read as an "out in the woods" experience. Typography was deliberately limited to two families to keep every touchpoint cohesive.

For the companion mobile app, secondary research included a deep look at existing smart-home practices — surveys and focus-group interviews aimed at surfacing the real pain points guests hit during a stay.

That research showed guests were enthusiastic about controlling multiple room devices and requesting services from one place, but wary of complexity — they wanted fast, obvious access to controls. Following the resulting user journey map, the key actions were brought forward onto the home screen, with tabs held in reserve for secondary features.

The interface stays simple to navigate, with contrast between UI elements built to WCAG standards for an inclusive experience with less eye fatigue. Gestalt principles guided the UX work throughout — grouping by region, layout grids for continuity, and consistent color for similarity — resulting in a clear, cohesive visual hierarchy.

projects.name: Hexcapes
projects.brief: A modern, recognizable identity for a cybersecurity company built around AI-driven threat prediction for government clients.

blocks.text: Hexcapes is a cybersecurity company building solutions tailored to government needs. Using AI and machine learning, its team works to predict and prevent cyber threats before they happen.

The re-brand set out to craft a recognizable, modern logotype backed by a full identity system — imagery, brand voice, typography, and iconography, plus social templates — all built to meet WCAG accessibility standards.

projects.name:
Museum of
Sound
projects.brief: A modern, inclusive identity for a museum reimagining how visitors experience sound.

blocks.text: The Museum of Sound's branding centers on accessibility and immersion — a move away from the traditional, static museum experience toward something dynamic and interactive. The identity foregrounds sound's multifaceted nature: its historical significance, but also its emotional, cultural, and technological impact.
The system, including logo and full visual identity, was built to feel modern and engaging while welcoming visitors of every age and background into the world of sound.
